_comment: Internal creative selection only (brief section 5.3); weights: mechanic 30, readability/focal hierarchy 25, polish/originality 20, fidelity to game art 15, portrait end-card reuse 10. Not a claim about store conversion.

concepts.title: A. Before / Loot / After
concepts.thesis: Plain player, the boss's two real drops in slots, the same player wearing them: a left-to-right story.

concepts.title: B. Wardrobe parade
concepts.thesis: Five looks across four seasons: variety, but not that looks come from enemies; bands read as quadrants.

concepts.title: C. Boss drop
concepts.thesis: The Red Fox spills its sword and outfit: strong mood, but the cropped boss is unreadable, no look changes.

concepts.title: FINAL (A refined with C's lighting)
concepts.thesis: Teal Dinosaur on Summer sand at sunset: boss with its Iron Sword, its real drops, the player wearing both.
